question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Futile**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Effective**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Futile"** means something that is incapable of producing any useful result or is pointless. (बेकार, व्यर्थ)
 
 
• **Example:** His attempts to fix the broken clock were futile because it was beyond repair.
 
 
 
• **"Effective"** refers to something that is successful in producing a desired or intended result. (प्रभावी)
 
 
• **Example:** The new marketing strategy was highly effective in increasing sales.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Futile'** is **'Effective'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Effective**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Useless** (बेकार): Not fulfilling or not able to fulfill any purpose or role.
 
 
• **Example:** The old phone is useless because it no longer works.
 
 
 
• **Pointless** (निरर्थक): Having little or no sense, use, or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** Continuing the debate seemed pointless since no one was willing to compromise.
 
 
 
• **Vain** (व्यर्थ): Producing no result or effect; futile.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite her efforts, all her attempts to win the contest were in vain.
 
 

48:T850,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
